lines.text: Claim struck. Not a cent. You are a hard people.
Fair price. Half to the families. I am going to be sick.
Sold on. The Undermarket thanks you. So do I.

choice.text: Tell me who is buying. The families deserve to know.
Tell me who is buying. The Warden should know.
Take the money and keep quiet.

lines.text: ...A Helix broker with a long coat. I will say it once. Once.
Knock on wood. Good doing business.
